tokensPerMinute.description:
Enforced tokens-per-minute for the scope. 0 = calibrate from provider
response headers, falling back to the scope's rate_limit configuration.

reservationTokensPerCall.description:
Token reservation charged per call at grant time, mirroring providers
that debit prompt-estimate + max_tokens at admission (Azure/OpenAI).
0 = derive from the requesting agent's max_tokens.

maxActiveConversations.description:
Ceiling on concurrently active (admitted, not parked) conversations.
0 = derive from measured capacity; see the design doc for the formula.

maxDoorQueue.description:
Door-queue depth beyond which new conversations are rejected with
RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED instead of queued.

starvationAgeS.description:
Seconds after which a waiting slot request is promoted one priority
class. Bounds starvation: any waiter reaches the top class in at most
2 * starvation_age_s.

utilizationTarget.description: Target utilization of measured capacity, (0, 1]. 0 = default 0.8.

interactiveHeadroom.description:
Fraction of the budget reserved for the interactive band, [0, 1).
Batch admission is capped at budget * (1 - interactive_headroom) so an
arriving human never waits behind a fully batch-reserved window.
0 = default 0.15.

v1LLMSchedulerConfig.description:
LLMSchedulerConfig configures one provider-scope scheduler. Zero values
mean "derive": from provider response telemetry where available, from the
scope's rate-limit configuration otherwise.

v1SlotOrigin.description:
SlotOrigin bands slot requests by who is waiting on the answer. The
interactive band outranks the batch band entirely: a human blocked on a
response experiences latency directly, while batch work only cares about
throughput. Within a band, SlotPriorityClass orders requests. Aging never
promotes across bands.

 - SLOT_ORIGIN_BATCH: Fleet/background work: workflows, task-board executions, sub-agent
fan-outs, scheduled runs.
 - SLOT_ORIGIN_INTERACTIVE: A human is waiting. Edge-triggered, per turn: the caller stamps
INTERACTIVE only on the calls of the single conversation-loop turn that
answers a human action (a chat message on an attached session, a HITL
response), then reverts to BATCH. A conversation is never interactive
for its lifetime — only for the loop a human is provably waiting on.

v1SlotPriorityClass.description:
SlotPriorityClass orders slot requests. Higher classes are served first;
aging promotes a starved waiter one class (liveness, not throughput).

 - SLOT_PRIORITY_CLASS_NEW: First LLM call of a conversation: admitted as churn allows.
 - SLOT_PRIORITY_CLASS_IN_FLIGHT: Conversation mid-task: run-to-completion bias — finishing releases every
resource the conversation holds.
 - SLOT_PRIORITY_CLASS_RESOURCE_HOLDER: Conversation holding an external scarce resource (database session
handle, MCP slot): priority inheritance — it is blocking other agents
that are burning LLM budget trying to acquire what it holds.

scope.description: The provider quota scope this scheduler protects.

activeConversations.description:
Conversations currently holding at least one grant or eligible to
request one.

parkedRequests.description: Slot requests currently parked waiting for capacity.

doorQueueDepth.description: Conversations queued at the admission door.

effectiveTokensPerMinute.description:
Effective tokens-per-minute after provider-telemetry calibration (or
AIMD for signal-free providers). This is the enforced number.

reservedTokensOutstanding.description: Sum of reservations for grants currently outstanding.

nextWake.description: Earliest scheduled wake (from Retry-After / window reset), if any.

grantsTotal.description: Grants issued and completed since scheduler start.

promotionsTotal.description:
Aging promotions since scheduler start (a rising rate means the scope is
saturated enough that liveness protection is doing real work).

v1SlotState.description: SlotState is the observable state of one scheduler scope.

promotions.description: Number of aging promotions applied to this waiter so far.

v1SlotWaiter.description: SlotWaiter describes one parked slot request.
